messages:
Rory: Heads-up 10am PT publish target for the product launch post. Need quick owners: hero line, bench stat + 1-line method, staging screenshot, top-banner webinar signup (prefill email), HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, legal quick-pass. Who can take each? :mag:

June: Ill do the hero + bench phrasing. Ill avoid absolutes and include a concise methodology parenthetical.

Faye: Ill grab the screenshot from staging and export hero/social crops (1200x630 + @2x). Please confirm demo route.

Rory: Use staging.app.redwood/demo-stream. Scrub org names.

Priya: Ill create the HubSpot form and add hidden fields: lead_source=blog_launch, product_interest=inference, orig_utm, company_size. Will support `?email=` prefill and wire UTMs for cta_a/cta_b.

DesignBot: Uploaded hero candidates: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_4077777777_hero.png 1200x630 recommended.

Marco (Legal): On the benchmark claim: change any absolute phrasing. Suggested language: "Internal benchmarks show up to a 60% reduction in per-token inference cost on representative workloads (see methodology)." Keep method high-level (sample size + baseline hardware + end-to-end measurement). Avoid "enterprise-grade." Use "built for production." 

June: Pushed two hero variants to /content/drafts/launch_hero_options.md and added the bench line plus method: "(10k request sample; baseline: 8xA100; end-to-end cost measured)."

Faye: Screenshot captured from staging route, scrubbed and exported PNG + webp. Uploaded.

Priya: UTMs set: `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content={hero_a|hero_b}`. Form supports email prefill and hidden fields added. SFDC routing: company_size>=500 -> Enterprise AE; else SMB SDR. Mark `product_interest=dedicated` as priority.

Marco (Legal): Quick-pass approved provided the bench line and high-level method remain. No SLA language. :white_check_mark:

Rory: Final checklist 1 react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done: hero locked, bench caveat included, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot + hidden fields in place, UTMs/A-B set, legal sign-off.

June: Hero + bench done. :white_check_mark:

Faye: Screenshots and exports done. :white_check_mark:

DesignBot: Assets optimized and social crop generated. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot form, hidden fields, UTMs, and prefill tested; SFDC mapping documented. :white_check_mark:

Marco (Legal): Legal sign-off complete. :white_check_mark:

Rory: Great 1 scheduling Thu 10am PT and adding top-banner webinar slot (Tue 11am PT) with prefill link. Will post publish stub in #release-war-room. :tada:
